name: Pete Ricketts
desc: United States Senator from Nebraska since 2023
summary:
John Peter  Ricketts (born August 19, 1964) is an American businessman and politician serving as the junior United States senator from Nebraska since 2023.   
A member of the Republican Party, Ricketts served from 2015 to 2023 as the 40th governor of Nebraska. He ran for the U.S. Senate in 2006, losing to incumbent Ben Nelson.
